notes.title: New very important update!
notes.content:
Hi guys,
I’ve released a new update. Here are the features-
-	A lot easier to get away from enemies!
-	Much less fog in the Cellar prisons allowing the player to see much further
-	Easier to open locker/wardrobe when inside 
-	Now has hand icon for door levers so that they are obviously interactable. 
-	Easier too lean in Cellar prisons round pillar without being seen
-       Easier to open trap door in the designer's room, and also easier to move 
        the bed
-       Can hide properly in cellar prisons without weirdly being seen through the 
        wall
Just as a note, the cellar prisons is where the player first has a high risk encounter with the first monster. :)

Thanks <3
